correctness.rationale: For r>1 and 0<L<H, reciprocation gives y(t+1)=(y(t)+(r−1)/K(t))/r, so the four-step contraction has a positive globally attracting orbit. Four cyclic weighted sums (1,r,r²,r³) give decreasing partial-sum gaps δ(r²−r), δ(r−1)², δ(r²−r) divided by r⁴−1, where δ=(r−1)(L^−1−H^−1)>0. Equal total sums and strict Karamata convexity of 1/y prove higher grouped arithmetic biomass mean but strictly lower trough and higher peak; six arrangements fall into exactly two rotations. Independent exact-fraction calculation for r=2,L=1/3,H=1 reproduced reciprocal gaps (4/15,2/15,4/15,0) and biomass mean difference 584/45045. These checks are examples, not real-parameter proof.
